MOON 2.x template.yml SCHEMA (verified). Example:
id: 'kata'
title: 'Coding Kata'
description: |
  Scaffolds a new coding kata package with test file, source stub, moon tasks.
destination: 'packages/[name | kebab_case]'
extends: ['base']
variables:
  name:
    type: 'string'
    required: true
    prompt: 'Kata name (kebab-case, e.g. four-squares)?'
    default: ''
`type` accepts: array, boolean, string, object, number, enum (no float support - use string). Enum supports `values` (list of string or {value,label}), `multiple: true`, `default`. `required` enforced only during prompting. `internal: true` (v1.23+) prevents CLI-arg overrides of that var. `order` (v1.23+) controls prompt sequence. `destination` supports `[varName]` bracket interpolation with filters, relative to CWD unless prefixed with `/` (workspace root relative).

moon 2.4.6 generator templates: Tera filename interpolation with square brackets WORKS as documented. File name `src/[name | kebab_case].ts` correctly renders to `src/scratch-verify.ts` when var name="scratch-verify". Filters camel_case, kebab_case confirmed working in both filenames and content ({{ name | camel_case }} -> scratchVerify). template.yml variables schema: `variables: <key>: { type: string, required: bool, default: "", prompt: "..." }` at top level (no wrapping 'vars' key) works correctly with `bunx moon generate <id> --to <dest> -- --varname "value"`. Also confirmed: bare `moon` on PATH can be a stale proto shim (2.2.5) while `bunx moon` resolves the package.json-pinned version (2.4.6) — always prefer `bunx moon` in scripts/CI to avoid version drift. Also: sandboxed bash rm -rf permission deny rules using glob pattern `rm -rf /*` will match ANY absolute path starting with `/` (e.g. `rm -rf /Users/...`), not just root — use relative paths with `workdir` param instead to avoid false-positive blocks.

MOON 2.x BUN TOOLCHAIN INTEGRATION - friction points found for katas repo.
CRITICAL GAP: current .moon/toolchains.yml only has:
bun:
  version: "1.3.8"
Per docs, to FULLY enable JS support via bun you need BOTH:
javascript:
  packageManager: 'bun'
bun:
  version: '1.3.8'
Without javascript.packageManager: 'bun', moon "is unable to automatically detect the correct runtime... defaults to Node.js because of its popularity" for TASK-LEVEL toolchain resolution when a task invokes a node_modules/.bin binary (not an issue if tasks call bun directly, since "the bun binary automatically sets the toolchain to Bun"). RECOMMEND ADDING javascript.packageManager: 'bun' to .moon/toolchains.yml - currently missing.

Bun + package.json workspaces: moon docs state it "will take package.json workspaces into account and install modules in the correct location; either the workspace root, in a project, or both." This implies root package.json SHOULD have a "workspaces" array matching packages/* (mirroring .moon/workspace.yml's projects: ["packages/*"]) for bun to correctly hoist/install deps per-package. Current root package.json has NO workspaces field - this is a gap, though no documented conflict/friction between moon's bun toolchain and a root workspaces array was found; docs describe them as complementary.
Moon manages installs itself via InstallDependencies action: "Node modules will automatically be installed if dependencies in package.json have changed, or the lockfile has changed, since the last time a task has ran" - controlled by toolchains.installDependencies (default true, v2.1+).
Relationships between projects auto-discovered from package.json dependencies/devDependencies/peerDependencies.

Moon 2.4.6 gotchas for bun/TS monorepo root config: (1) bare `moon` on PATH can be a stale proto shim (2.2.5) while `bunx moon` resolves the pinned devDependency version (2.4.6) — always use `bunx moon` and verify both with `moon --version` vs `bunx moon --version` if config uses newer fields. (2) `.moon/toolchains.yml` needs BOTH `bun: { version }` AND `javascript: { packageManager: 'bun' }` — bun alone doesn't register the JS toolchain. (3) Inherited tasks for all projects go in `.moon/tasks/all.yml` (directory form), NOT singular `.moon/tasks.yml` (removed in 2.0). (4) `moon run <target>` has NO `--dry-run` flag in 2.4.6 — that flag doesn't exist; use `moon query projects`/`moon query tasks` (exit 0, JSON output) to validate config parses without executing anything. (5) `moon check --all` requires a TTY or explicit project IDs even with --all in some setups — throws `app::tty::required_id`; not reliable for non-interactive CI-style verification. (6) With zero projects yet (empty packages/*), `moon run :test` correctly emits 'No tasks found. Unable to execute action pipeline' with exit 1 — this is expected/correct behavior, not a config error, since inherited tasks only materialize once a project exists to inherit them.

Advanced-tier kata scaffolding (15 packages) via `bunx moon generate kata --to packages/<dir> -- --name ... --title ... --description ... --source ...` worked identically to beginner/intermediate tiers on moon 2.4.6/bun 1.3.8. Workspace now 61/61 packages, all typecheck green, spot-checked 3 (wallet, orm, pac-man) all RED at genuine `throw new Error("Not implemented")` — no config/import errors. Multi-file-system-sounding katas (ORM, Social Network, CQRS Booking, JEE WebAuthentication, PacMan) were still scaffolded with the same single-function stub template per instructions — do not over-engineer scaffolds for katas that "sound" like they need multiple files.

MOON 2.x RESEARCH - MIGRATION RISKS / UNVERIFIED ITEMS for katas repo setup (installed @moonrepo/cli 2.4.6, but proto shim on PATH resolves to moon 2.2.5 - version mismatch, verify which binary actually executes, e.g. via `bunx moon` vs global `moon`, before relying on 2.3/2.4-specific fields like task `checks`, `mergeChecks`, per-project `taskOptions`, workspace `cache.cas`).
1. `.moon/templates/` as default template location is WRONG - corrected to `./templates/` (workspace root, not inside .moon/).
2. `local: true` task field NOT FOUND in 2.x project config docs - appears v1-only, replaced by preset:'utility' or options.cache/options.runInCI.
3. `platform` task field replaced by `toolchains` (plural array) in 2.x - do not use old `platform` field name from v1 tutorials.
4. Whether singular `.moon/tasks.yml` (no subdir) still works in 2.x vs required `.moon/tasks/*.yml` directory form was NOT explicitly confirmed - only directory form shown in fetched 2.x docs, recommend using directory form.
5. Tera `title` filter capitalizing each word (used for kebab->Title Case heading conversion) inferred from Tera's standard/built-in filter set (Twig/Jinja/Django convention), NOT empirically tested against the installed Tera version bundled in @moonrepo/cli 2.4.6.
6. Current repo gaps identified: .moon/toolchains.yml missing `javascript: {packageManager: 'bun'}`; root package.json missing `workspaces: ["packages/*"]` array. Both are doc-recommended additions, not confirmed-broken without them.

MOON 2.x TEMPLATES - LOCATION & REGISTRATION (verified moonrepo.dev v2 docs, installed @moonrepo/cli 2.4.6, katas repo). Default template search path is `<workspaceRoot>/templates/` NOT `.moon/templates/` (original assumption was wrong - flag as corrected). .moon/workspace.yml `generator.templates` defaults to `./templates`; since our workspace.yml has no `generator:` block, moon auto-discovers `./templates/<name>/template.yml` with NO registration needed. To use a custom location (e.g. .moon/templates/) you must set:
generator:
  templates:
    - './templates'
    - './.moon/templates'
Also supports glob://, git://, npm:// locators for sharing templates across repos.
Template folder layout: templates/kata/{template.yml, index.ts, index.test.ts, README.md}. Template ID defaults to folder name, override with `id:` field in template.yml.

katas-manifest.json built from https://codingdojo.org/kata/ (61 katas, single page, no pagination). Tier counts: beginner 28, intermediate 18, advanced 15 — matches expected. 6 renames applied: Brainfuck→tape-machine-interpreter (originalName null, per profanity policy — only the source URL retains the reference, which is explicitly permitted), Potter→book-set-discount-pricing, Gilded Rose→inventory-quality-updater, Elephant Carpaccio→pos-ticket-slicing, Lags→interval-scheduling-max-profit, Pagination Seven→pagination-display (last 5 keep originalName set). 28 known-good beginner dirs reused verbatim from prior pass. Intermediate/advanced dirs newly derived as kebab-case of published names. Validated: unique dirs, regex-valid, JSON.parse OK, no missing descriptions/sources.

moon 2.4.6 kata generator + task pipeline verified end-to-end working (not just config-parses). Working generator invocation: `bunx moon generate kata --to packages/<name> -- --name "x" --title "X" --description "..." --source "url"` (note the `--` separator before vars). Task execution confirmed real: `bunx moon run <pkg>:test`, `bunx moon run <pkg>:typecheck`, `bunx moon run :test` (wildcard form correctly resolves to all matching pkg:test tasks), and root `bun run test` (which just shells to `bunx moon run :test`) all execute the actual `bun test`/`tsc --noEmit` processes and propagate correct exit codes (1 on real test failure, 0 on pass) — not just moon config validation. No fixes needed to .moon/tasks/all.yml or tsconfig.json; the root config from prior workers was already correct. First moon run does `bun install` + proto bootstrap as a side effect (slow), subsequent runs are fast/cached.

MOON 2.x TASK INHERITANCE mechanism (confirmed) - lets each kata's moon.yml stay nearly empty.
File location: .moon/tasks/*.yml (directory of yml files) is the CONFIRMED 2.x pattern from official docs, e.g. .moon/tasks/all.yml. Docs state: "The .moon/tasks/**/* files configure file groups and tasks that are inherited by every matching project." Could NOT confirm whether a single top-level .moon/tasks.yml (no subdirectory) still works in 2.x - only directory form shown; recommend directory form.

Recommended .moon/tasks/all.yml for katas repo:
fileGroups:
  sources: ['*.ts']
  tests: ['*.test.ts']
tasks:
  test:
    command: 'bun test'
    inputs: ['@group(sources)', '@group(tests)']
    options:
      cache: false
  typecheck:
    command: 'tsc --noEmit'
    inputs: ['@group(sources)', '/tsconfig.json']

Conditional inheritance (2.0+): inheritedBy map restricts which projects get a tasks file's config, based on toolchains/stacks/layers:
inheritedBy:
  toolchains:
    or: ['javascript', 'typescript']
  layers: ['library']
When inheritedBy omitted, config inherited by ALL projects.
Also supports implicitDeps/implicitInputs (always-inherited regardless of merge strategy), taskOptions (workspace-level default options, overridable per-task/per-project via 2.4+ moon.yml taskOptions), extends (inherit from URL/file).
Merge strategy for project overrides: options.merge/mergeArgs/mergeDeps/mergeEnv/mergeInputs/mergeOutputs/mergeTags(2.3+)/mergeToolchains(2.0+)/mergeChecks(2.4+), default "append".

MOON 2.x TEMPLATE VARIABLE INTERPOLATION & CASE CONVERSION (verified, engine = Tera, Rust Twig/Jinja-like).
File CONTENT: {{ varName }}, filters via pipe: {{ varName | camel_case }}.
File NAME/PATH: bracket syntax [varName], filters: [varName | camel_case] (brackets not curly-braces in filenames; spaces in filter output can break path encoding, mainly relevant to destination).
Custom moonrepo Tera filters (case conversion): camel_case, pascal_case, snake_case, upper_snake_case, kebab_case, upper_kebab_case, lower_case, upper_case. Plus path filters: path_join, path_relative. Function variables() (v1.23+) returns all vars as object. Always-available vars: dest_dir, dest_rel_dir, working_dir, workspace_root.

SOLVING THE 3-CASE PROBLEM for kata "four-squares":
- dir name (kebab-case): destination: 'packages/[name | kebab_case]' or just [name] if input already kebab.
- export identifier (camelCase "fourSquares"): {{ name | camel_case }} in file content.
- heading Title Case ("Four Squares"): NO built-in title-from-kebab filter exists. Compose: {{ name | replace(from="-", to=" ") | title }} using Tera's built-in replace and title filters - NOT empirically tested against installed Tera version, inferred from Tera's documented built-in filter set.

FILE EXTENSIONS: .tera (preferred) or .twig enable editor syntax highlighting, stripped on generation. Optional.
PARTIALS: files with "partial" anywhere in path used for Tera include/inheritance, NOT generated to destination, no frontmatter support.
RAW (v1.11+): .raw extension bypasses Tera rendering entirely, extension stripped on output.
ASSETS: binary files copied as-is, no rendering, no frontmatter.

MOON 2.x moon.yml for bun/TS kata. Field name is toolchains (plural array) not toolchain/platform (v1 name, deprecated). local:true task field NOT FOUND in v2 docs - v1-only, use preset:'utility' or options:{cache:false,runInCI:false} instead. Recommended moon.yml: language:'typescript', layer:'library', tasks omitted (inherited). language values: bash,batch,go,javascript,php,python,ruby,rust,typescript,unknown,custom. layer values: application,automation,configuration,library,scaffolding,tool,unknown - kata fits library. stack optional, omit for katas. If overriding tasks: command='bun test'/'tsc --noEmit', inputs=['*.ts','*.test.ts'], omit outputs (no build artifacts). args field appends to inherited command; command is full invocation.
